title: Regulation of Generation Transmission and Distribution of Electric Power Amendment Ordinance 1999

sections.shortTitle: Regulation of Generation Transmission and Distribution of Electric Power Amendment Ordinance 1999
sections.description:
Short title application and commencement

ORDINANCE XXIV OF 1999
REGULATION OF GENERATION,
TRANSMISSION AND DISTRIBUTION OF ELECTRIC PQWER (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1999
ORDINANCE XXIV OF 1999
An
Ordinance to amend the Regulation of Generation, Transmission and Distribution
of Electric Power Act, 1997
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 30th December, 1999]
F.No.2(I)/99-Pub., dated
30-12-1999.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published
for general information:-
1. Short title, application
and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Regulation of
Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electric Power (Amendment)
Ordinance, 1999.
(2) It shall apply to all
appointments whether made before or after the commencement of this Ordinance.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Regulation of Generation Transmission and Distribution of Electric Power Amendment Ordinance 1999
sections.description:
Amendment of section 3 Act XL of 1997

ORDINANCE XXIV OF 1999
REGULATION OF GENERATION,
TRANSMISSION AND DISTRIBUTION OF ELECTRIC PQWER (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1999
ORDINANCE XXIV OF 1999
An
Ordinance to amend the Regulation of Generation, Transmission and Distribution
of Electric Power Act, 1997
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 30th December, 1999]
F.No.2(I)/99-Pub., dated
30-12-1999.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published
for general information:-
2. Amendment of section 3, Act
XL of 1997.--In the Regulation of Generation, Transmission and Distribution
of Electric Power Act, 1997 (XL of 1997), in section 3, in subsection (5), in
the proviso for the words "not be appointed under subsection (1) if he has
already attained" the words "retire on attaining" shall be
substituted.
